name: Default
shortDescription: Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents search dashboards, query Prometheus and Loki, manage alerts and incidents in an existing Grafana instance over streamable HTTP.

alerts.message: Set GRAFANA_URL to your Grafana 9.0+ instance and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN to a service account token from that instance (the Editor role covers most tools), then redeploy. Until then every tool call fails.

Point your MCP client at https://<your-domain>/mcp and send an Authorization: Bearer header with the generated MCP_GRAFANA_SERVER_TOKEN from the environment settings. A custom domain must also be added to MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS (comma-separated) or requests are rejected with 403.
